earnings.title: nVent Delivers Record Sales and Orders in Q3 2026
highlights: Reported EPS of $1.23 up 68%; Adjusted EPS of $1.52 up 67%
Reported EPS of $4.54 to $4.57; Adjusted EPS of $5.36 to $5.39
Reported sales of $1.5 billion, both reported and organic sales up 44%
Cash Flows of $303 million up 12%; Free Cash Flow of $268 million up 6%
Reported sales growth of 48% to 49%; Organic sales growth of 38% to 39%

quotes.text: We had another strong quarter, with record sales and orders. We saw double digit sales growth in all verticals, led by infrastructure.
quotes.by: Beth Wozniak, nVent chair and chief executive officer

outlook: The company now estimates reported sales growth for full-year 2026 of 48 to 49 percent versus prior guidance of 37 to 39 percent.
This new guidance range reflects 38 to 39 percent organic sales growth versus prior guidance of 32 to 34 percent.

The company now expects full-year 2026 EPS of $4.54 to $4.57 on a GAAP basis and adjusted EPS of $5.36 to $5.39, versus prior guidance of $4.29 to $4.39 on a GAAP basis and adjusted EPS of $5.00 to $5.10.
The company estimates fourth quarter 2026 reported sales growth of 45 to 48 percent and organic sales growth of 26 to 29 percent.

items.heading: General global economic and business conditions affect demand for our products.
We compete in attractive markets with a high level of competition, which may result in pressure on our profit margins and limit our ability to maintain or increase the market share of our products.

Our future growth is dependent upon our ability to adapt our products, services and organization to meet the demands of local markets in both developed and emerging economies and by developing or acquiring new technologies that achieve market acceptance with acceptable margins.
We may not be able to identify, finance and complete suitable acquisitions and investments, and any completed acquisitions and investments could be unsuccessful or consume significant resources.
We may not achieve some or all of the expected benefits of our business initiatives.
We may experience material cost and other inflation.
